## Multi-Recipient Personalized Campaign

Sends personalized emails to a contact list with rate limiting.

**Flow:**
1. Webhook triggers campaign with template and subject
2. Read contacts from Google Sheets
3. Code personalizes {{variables}} for each contact
4. Rate limit (2s between sends) to avoid Gmail throttling
5. Gmail sends personalized email
6. Track delivery in Sheets

**Webhook payload:**
```json
{
  "campaignId": "CAMP-001",
  "subject": "Hi {{name}}, special offer for {{company}}",
  "template": "Hi {{name}},\n\nAs {{role}} at {{company}}, you might be interested in..."
}
```

**Contact Sheets columns:** email, name, company, role
**Tracking Sheets columns:** campaignId, recipient, name, company, subject, sentAt, status
